cases.prompt: Is aside installed and what is it?
cases.expected_behavior: Runs aside --version before availability claims and identifies Aside as a browser agent that executes natural-language tasks in a real browser.

cases.prompt: qmd search fails with a Node error. What should I do?
cases.expected_behavior: Names the Node 26 ABI incompatibility and directs the user to use Node 24.
assertions: Does not invent a QMD command as a fix.

cases.prompt: Upgrade obsidian-cli and tell me whether it is available.
cases.expected_behavior: Uses command -v and obsidian-cli --version for preflight without running an upgrade as a probe.
assertions: Does not run an upgrade as a probe.
